name: coding-guides
description: Injects the user's standing coding conventions (tool-use, git, PR, code-structure, and skill-handling preferences) into every session via SessionStart hooks, gives subagents the code-writing ones via SubagentStart hooks, and enforces select rules (e.g. single-line commit messages) via a PreToolUse hook. Ships a pi adapter that injects the same guides and enforces the same rules from the same files, and two user-invoked skills: /auto-deliver hands the rest of a feature to the agent, and /tldr gives a short, plain-language executive summary.
